content:
**Science!** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Increases Energy damage based on current Intelligence.

| ![FO76 science! perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/9/9d/FO76_science%21_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Intelligence | Energy Damage | 
| | 1 | +5% | 
| | 15 | +22% | 
| | 30 | +35% | 
| | 60 | +45% | 
| | 100 | +50% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Increase energy damage based on your INT. | 003440C0 | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Science." It used to have 2 ranks that provided +5%/+10% damage to non-heavy energy weapons. Rank 1 of this perk was required for crafting energy weapons, while rank 2 of this perk allowed for crafting rank 1 energy weapon mods. With this rework the perk is no longer needed to craft any weapons or mods.
